questions.stem: Eating food and drinking water is a life process called…
questions.explanation: Nutrition means eating and drinking. The other life processes are growth, movement and reproduction (having young).

questions.stem: Match each life process to what it means.
questions.explanation: People and animals all do these life processes: nutrition, growth, movement and reproduction.

questions.stem: Sort the foods into everyday foods and treats.
questions.explanation: Rice, fruit, vegetables and fish are healthy everyday foods. Cake, sweets, fried chips and doughnuts are very sweet or fatty, so they are treats for sometimes.

questions.stem: Which is the healthiest snack?
questions.explanation: An apple is a fruit and a healthy snack. Sweets and chips are very sweet or very fatty, so they are treats.

questions.stem: Which one do we use with water to wash germs off our hands?
questions.explanation: Washing hands with soap and water gets rid of germs. A toothbrush is for teeth and a pencil is for writing.

questions.stem: Match each picture to why it helps your body.
pairs: makes the heart and muscles strong
helps the body rest and grow
questions.explanation: Exercise makes the heart and muscles strong. Sleep helps the body rest and grow. Soap gets rid of germs. Water keeps the body working.

questions.stem: Which of these foods can hurt your teeth if you eat a lot of them? Choose all that are right.
questions.explanation: Sweets, lollipops and cake have a lot of sugar, and sugar hurts teeth. Apples and rice are not very sugary.

questions.stem: The four life processes are nutrition, growth, movement and ___.
questions.explanation: Reproduction means having young. A hen lays eggs and a person has babies.

questions.stem: Children should sleep about ___ hours every night so their bodies can rest and grow.
questions.explanation: About 10 hours of sleep helps a child's body rest, grow and be ready for the next day.

questions.stem: Sweets and fizzy drinks are treats, not everyday food.
questions.explanation: Very sweet foods can damage our health if we eat too much of them. They are treats for sometimes.

questions.stem: If one part of your body does not work well, the other parts find it harder too.
questions.explanation: The body works as a team. For example, the heart and lungs work together, so looking after the whole body matters.

questions.stem: Which body process does each part help with? Sort them.
questions.explanation: The stomach and small intestine break down food (digestion). The lungs take in air, the heart pumps blood, and the kidneys and large intestine help the body get rid of waste.

questions.stem: Which of these are healthy habits? Choose all that are right.
options: wash your hands with soap before eating
brush your teeth twice a day
eat only sweets and fizzy drinks
questions.explanation: Washing hands, brushing teeth and exercising keep the body healthy. Eating only sweets and fizzy drinks, or staying awake all night, harm the body.

questions.stem: Put the steps of washing your hands in order.
sequence: Wet your hands with clean water.
Rub soap all over your hands.
Dry your hands with a clean cloth.
questions.explanation: Wet your hands, rub soap all over, rinse the soap and germs away with clean water, then dry your hands.

questions.stem: Why is it bad to eat sweets every day?
questions.model_answer: Too much sugar can hurt your teeth and make you unhealthy.
questions.explanation: Sweets have a lot of sugar. Too much sugar can hurt your teeth and make you unhealthy.

questions.stem: How do the lungs and the heart work as a team?
options: The lungs mash food and the heart makes urine.
The heart takes in air and the lungs pump blood.
The heart and lungs only work when we run.
The lungs take in air and the heart pumps blood round the body.
questions.explanation: The lungs take in air with oxygen. The heart pumps blood, and the blood carries the oxygen around the body.

questions.stem: Every day Shopon buys crisps and a fizzy drink for his tiffin. In the afternoon he feels tired and his teeth hurt. What is the best change?
options: Skip his tiffin and just play.
Pack a roti with egg, a banana and water.
questions.explanation: Crisps and fizzy drinks do not give lasting energy, and sugar hurts teeth. A roti with egg, a banana and water is a healthy tiffin.

questions.stem: Priya has been playing in the mud. It is time for lunch. What should she do first?
options: Wipe her hands on her clothes.
Wash her hands with soap and water.
questions.explanation: Hands pick up germs from mud. Washing with soap and water before eating washes the germs away so they do not make us ill.

questions.stem: Arif is 7 years old. He must get up at 6 in the morning for school. About what time should he go to bed to sleep for about 10 hours?
questions.explanation: Ten hours before 6 in the morning is 8 at night. Children need about 10 hours of sleep so their bodies can rest and grow.

questions.stem: Rina is packing a healthy tiffin. Which things should she pack? Choose all that are right.
questions.explanation: A roti with egg, a banana and a bottle of water are healthy. Fried chips and a fizzy drink are treats for sometimes.

questions.stem: Imran says, 'I play football every day, so I do not need to eat healthy food.' Is Imran right?
questions.explanation: Exercise is important, but the body also needs healthy, varied food to grow and have energy. We need both.

questions.stem: Class 2B asked 20 children how long they sleep (example data): 8 hours: 4 children, 9 hours: 5 children, 10 hours: 9 children, 11 hours: 2 children. How many children sleep fewer than 10 hours?
questions.explanation: Fewer than 10 hours means 8 hours and 9 hours: 4 + 5 = 9 children.

questions.stem: Shopon's crisps and fizzy drink cost 40 Tk a day. His tiffin from home costs 25 Tk a day (example prices). How much does he save in 5 school days?
questions.explanation: Each day he saves 40 − 25 = 15 Tk. In 5 days he saves 5 × 15 = 75 Tk.

questions.stem: Raju says, 'Sweets give me energy, so I do not need vegetables or fish.' What is wrong with his idea?
options: Sweets are healthy if they are very sweet.
A healthy diet needs many kinds of food, not only sweets.
Raju should drink fizzy drinks too.
questions.explanation: Sweets give a quick burst of sugar, but they do not give the body everything it needs. A healthy diet is varied: vegetables, fruit, rice, fish or eggs, and water.

questions.stem: Explain how your heart and lungs work together as a team when you run.
questions.model_answer: My lungs take in more air and my heart pumps blood faster to carry it to my muscles.
questions.explanation: When you run, your lungs take in more air and your heart pumps blood faster. The blood carries the oxygen to your hard-working muscles.

questions.stem: Animals do the same life processes as people: nutrition, growth, movement and reproduction.
questions.explanation: People and animals both eat and drink, grow, move and have young. These are the life processes.
